title: Mrs. Lucy Durrett
text:
Mrs. Lucy Durrett

SAVOY — Funeral services was held Tuesday, at 2:30 p.m. in the First Baptist Church for Mrs. Lucy Durrett, 80, who died Monday 8:30 a.m. in the home of her daughter, Mrs. Maurive Owens in Leonard.

The Rev. C. H. Longino of Omaha and the Rev. W. A. Rudd of Campbell conducted the services. Burial was in Sunnyside Cemetery, directed by Earnheart Funeral Home.

Mrs. Durrett was born July 24, 1879 in Georgia, a daughter of the late Mr. and Mrs. J. W. Dodd. She was a member of the Savoy Baptist Church. She came to Savoy as a child and was married here in 1898 to W. H. Durrett.

Survivors besides her daughter, are one son, Duke Durrett of Savoy; two grandchildren and two great-grandchildren.
